0000.png.text: You can have Devin turn your one-star app reviews into fixes automatically, every night or whenever new reviews come in. It reproduces each bug on iOS and Android and fixes them in one pull request.

0001.png.text: In this demo, we start it by hand. The app has bugs we planted on purpose, and the reviews are demo data in the real App Store Connect and Google Play formats.

0002.png.text: First, Devin reads every review and groups the complaints into themes, each tied to the likely cause in the code.

0003.png.text: Here it found four bug themes. One review complained about ads, but the app has no ads, and two were feature requests, so those stay out.

0004.png.text: Next, it starts two managed Devins: a macOS session for the iOS Simulator, and a Linux session running the Android emulator.

0013.png.text: Use it to triage a review export, tell real bugs from other complaints, reproduce before fixing, and re-verify before you merge.
